matched_duplicate_policy: Equal row budgets and sample seeds reproduce identical samples; reference model labels are not independent samples. Three sample seeds per unique budget.
zero_reporting: qerror_* is all-query floor1 diagnostic; qerror_positive_* excludes truth zero; zero estimate counts and distribution are separate. stress is historical v1; stress_v2 canonical.
latency_correction: Model timing excludes host numpy mask construction; includes host-mask to GPU conversion/transfer and synchronized inference. Raw older wording includes host masks was ambiguous.
ranges_policy: Median and min-max of per-run query quantiles; descriptive grid, not a confidence interval or pooled-query quantile. Training and MC seed counts retained.
historical_field_correction: matched raw reference_checkpoint_bytes is parameter budget; corrected analysis reports actual_reference_checkpoint_bytes from training receipt
scope: numerical supplementary matrices only; PG and upstream compatibility have separate independent receipts
